text_en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled before the Philistines, and fell slain on Mount Gilboa.
text_cn: 那时，培肋舍特攻打以色列，以色列人由培肋舍特人面前逃走，在基耳波亚山上阵亡的人很多。

text_en: The Philistines overtook Saul and his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan and Abinadab and Malchishua, sons of Saul.
text_cn: 培肋舍特人追击撒乌耳和他的儿子，杀了撒乌耳的儿子约纳堂、阿彼纳达布和玛耳基叔亚；

text_en: The battle pressed hard on Saul; and the archers found him, and he was wounded by the archers.
text_cn: 战争就集中攻打撒乌耳，弓箭手发现了他，他遂为弓箭手所射伤。

text_en: Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, so that these uncircumcised may not come and make sport of me. ” But his armor-bearer was unwilling, for he was terrified. So Saul took his own sword and fell on it.
text_cn: 当时撒乌耳对自己的执戟（jǐ）者说：“拔出你的剑来，将我刺死，免得那些未受割损的人来凌辱我。”但是，执戟者十分害怕，不肯作这事；于是撒乌耳拔出剑来，伏剑自刎。

text_en: When his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he also fell on his sword and died.
text_cn: 执戟者见撒乌耳已死，也伏剑自刎。

text_en: Thus Saul died; he and his three sons and all his house died together.
text_cn: 这样，撒乌耳和他的三个儿子，并他的全家一同阵亡了。

text_en: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that the army had fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their towns and fled; and the Philistines came and occupied them.
text_cn: 所有住在平原的以色列人见军队逃散，撒乌耳和他的三个儿子阵亡了，也都弃城逃走；培肋舍特人遂来住在那里。

text_en: The next day when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
text_cn: 次日，培肋舍特人来剥去阵亡者的衣服时，发现撒乌耳和他的儿子横卧在基耳波亚山上。

text_en: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to carry the good news to their idols and to the people.
text_cn: 他们便剥去了他的衣服，取下他的首级和武器，送到培肋舍特地方，到处给他们的神和人民报喜信。

text_en: They put his armor in the temple of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
text_cn: 以后，将撒乌耳的武器放在他们的神庙里；将他的首级钉在达贡庙内。

text_en: But when all Jabesh-gilead heard everything that the Philistines had done to Saul,
text_cn: 基肋阿得雅贝士的居民，一听说培肋舍特人对撒乌耳所行的一切，

text_en: all the valiant warriors got up and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh. Then they buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
text_cn: 所有的勇士便起身前去，收殓了撒乌耳和他儿子的尸体，带回雅贝士，将他们的骨骸葬于雅贝士的笃(dǔ)耨(nòu)香树下，且禁食七天。

text_en: So Saul died for his unfaithfulness; he was unfaithful to the Lord in that he did not keep the command of the Lord ; moreover, he had consulted a medium, seeking guidance,
text_cn: 撒乌耳之死，是由于他背叛上主，没有遵守上主的话，并且还求问过招魂的女巫，

text_en: and did not seek guidance from the Lord . Therefore the Lord put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.
text_cn: 而没有求问上主；因此上主使他死亡，将王位移交给叶瑟的儿子达味。
